product_updates.title: Enveda secures $311M to bring more nature-derived AI drugs into clinical trials
product_updates.content: The round valued the AI biotech at $2 billion. It is currently testing drugs that treat skin conditions and preserve weight loss after stopping GLP-1s.

product_updates.title: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
product_updates.content: The report suggests that greater exposure will not resolve the unease around the technology, nor reduce public support for AI regulation.

product_updates.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
product_updates.content: Built directly into the YouTube Music app, Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language rather than searching for individual songs or artists.

product_updates.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
product_updates.content: YouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.
